opinions: I WORRY THAT INFOTAINMENT UNDERMINES PUBLIC DISCOURSE BY BLURRING FACTS AND SENSATIONALISM.
I DISAGREE; MORALITY CAN BE GROUNDED IN SECULAR ETHICS, EMPATHY, AND REASON WITHOUT RELIGION.
I SUPPORT ALLOWING STABLE SAME-SEX COUPLES TO ADOPT BECAUSE LOVING HOMES BENEFIT CHILDREN.
DISCIPLINE IS IMPORTANT BUT NOT THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT THING CHILDREN MUST LEARN.
A TRUE COMPETITIVE MARKET NEEDS ANTITRUST LIMITS TO PREVENT MONOPOLISTIC ABUSES BY MULTINATIONALS.
YES, GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT DELIBERATELY MISLEAD CONSUMERS TO PROTECT THE PUBLIC.
AVOIDANCE CAN HELP SHORT-TERM, BUT CONFRONTING PROBLEMS AND SEEKING SUPPORT IS HEALTHIER LONG-TERM.
I VALUE BOTH ECONOMIC PRODUCTION AND CULTURAL CREATION; WRITERS AND ARTISTS MATTER AS MUCH AS BUSINESSPEOPLE.
ABSTRACT ART CAN BE VALID ART BECAUSE ARTISTIC VALUE ISN'T LIMITED TO REPRESENTATION.
I REJECT ONE-PARTY STATES; AVOIDING DEBATE BY SILENCING DISSENT HARMS JUSTICE AND LONG-TERM PROGRESS.
I AGREE CORPORATIONS NEED REGULATION TO PREVENT ENVIRONMENTAL HARM WHEN VOLUNTARY MEASURES FAIL.
MARKETS CAN EXPAND FREEDOM SOMETIMES, BUT UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN ALSO CREATE COERCIVE INEQUITIES.
I RESPECT THE PRINCIPLE AS ASPIRATIONAL FOR SOLIDARITY, THOUGH ITS PRACTICAL IMPLEMENTATION IS COMPLEX.
I AGREE CULTURES DIFFER, AND LABELING SOME AS 'SAVAGE' IS PREJUDICED AND HARMFUL.
I SUPPORT DECRIMINALIZING PERSONAL CANNABIS POSSESSION AND FOCUSING ON PUBLIC HEALTH APPROACHES.
I REJECT A RIGID HIERARCHY AS A SOCIETAL IDEAL; AUTHORITY MUST BE ACCOUNTABLE AND NOT ABSOLUTE.
I DISAGREE THAT MOTHERS' PRIMARY DUTY IS HOMEMAKING; PARENTS SHOULD CHOOSE ROLES FREELY.
QUESTIONING AUTHORITY IS HEALTHY, THOUGH SOME PRAGMATIC RESPECT FOR LEGITIMATE, ACCOUNTABLE AUTHORITY IS NEEDED.
COMPROMISE WITH INSTITUTIONS CAN BE WISE, BUT UNCRITICAL ACCOMMODATION SHOULDN'T BE CONFLATED WITH MATURITY.
I STRONGLY OPPOSE DENYING REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS TO PEOPLE WITH INHERITABLE DISABILITIES; THAT'S DISCRIMINATORY AND UNETHICAL.
PUBLICLY FUNDED BROADCASTING CAN SERVE THE PUBLIC INTEREST AND PLURALISM, SO I SUPPORT IT IN MANY CASES.
I REJECT THE CLAIM; SEXUAL ORIENTATION IS A NATURAL PART OF IDENTITY FOR MANY PEOPLE.
I DON'T BELIEVE SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS USUALLY IMMORAL; CONSENSUAL ADULT RELATIONSHIPS ARE A PRIVATE MATTER.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS BENEFITS FOR HEALTH AND EQUALITY, THOUGH BOUNDARIES AND CONTEXT STILL MATTER.
I OPPOSE MAKING ALL ABORTIONS ILLEGAL; WOMEN NEED AUTONOMY AND SAFE ACCESS, WITH REASONABLE REGULATIONS.
I THINK RELIGIOUS VALUES CAN BE ONE PART OF EDUCATION, BUT PUBLIC SCHOOLS SHOULD RESPECT PLURALISM.
I DISAGREE; CORPORATE SUCCESS DOESN'T AUTOMATICALLY EQUATE TO PUBLIC BENEFIT AND OFTEN REQUIRES OVERSIGHT.
THE SAYING CAN BE TACTICALLY TRUE SOMETIMES, BUT ALLIES CHOSEN ONLY BY MUTUAL ENEMIES ARE UNRELIABLE.
I AGREE THAT CONSENSUAL PRIVATE SEXUAL ACTIVITY BETWEEN ADULTS SHOULD BE OFF-LIMITS TO STATE INTRUSION.
I BELIEVE MANY CIVIL LIBERTIES HAVE BEEN OVER-CURTAILED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM AND REQUIRE REVIEW.
I REJECT THE IDEA THAT FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN NEVER INTEGRATE; MANY DO INTEGRATE SUBSTANTIALLY OVER TIME.
CLASS DIVISIONS ARE POWERFUL, BUT NATIONALITY, CULTURE, AND OTHER IDENTITIES ALSO MEANINGFULLY DIVIDE PEOPLE.
PREPARING STUDENTS FOR WORK IS IMPORTANT, BUT SCHOOLING SHOULD ALSO DEVELOP CRITICAL THINKING AND CIVIC SKILLS.
LUCK INFLUENCES LIFE OUTCOMES FOR MANY, BUT STRUCTURAL FACTORS AND CHOICES ALSO PLAY MAJOR ROLES.
I DISAGREE; COMPANIES HAVE BROADER RESPONSIBILITIES TO WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, AND THE ENVIRONMENT BEYOND PROFIT.
COMPULSORY ATTENDANCE IS IMPORTANT FOR ENSURING EDUCATIONAL ACCESS AND EQUITABLE FOUNDATIONS FOR CHILDREN.
I THINK LAND HAS SOCIAL VALUE BEYOND COMMODIFICATION AND SHOULD BE MANAGED WITH PUBLIC INTEREST PROTECTIONS.
I SHARE THAT REGRET AND THINK ECONOMIES SHOULD REWARD PRODUCTIVE CONTRIBUTION, NOT JUST SPECULATIVE GAIN.
BOTH MATTER, BUT PRIORITIZING INFLATION CONTROL AT THE COST OF MASS UNEMPLOYMENT RISKS SEVERE HUMAN HARM.
I REJECT LITERAL RETALIATION; JUSTICE SHOULD BE PROPORTIONATE, HUMANE, AND FOCUSED ON PREVENTION AND REHABILITATION.
WHILE INTERNATIONAL LAW MATTERS, I WORRY ABOUT JUSTIFYING ILLEGAL MILITARY ACTION; EXCEPTIONAL CASES REQUIRE STRICT SCRUTINY.
CHARITY IS VALUABLE, BUT SOCIAL SECURITY PROVIDES CONSISTENT, RIGHTS-BASED SUPPORT THAT CHARITY ALONE CANNOT RELIABLY DELIVER.
IT'S NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO HAVE SOME PRIVACY, THOUGH OPENNESS AND TRUST BETWEEN PARENTS AND CHILDREN ARE IMPORTANT.
I REJECT SEGREGATIONIST IDEAS; SOCIETAL FLOURISHING DEPENDS ON INCLUSION, NOT PEOPLE KEEPING TO THEIR OWN KIND.
WHETHER TAXES ARE TOO HIGH DEPENDS ON FAIRNESS AND SERVICES PROVIDED; I SUPPORT PROGRESSIVE TAXATION FUNDING PUBLIC GOODS.
I SUPPORT LEGAL ACCESS TO ADULT PORNOGRAPHY WITH SAFEGUARDS AGAINST EXPLOITATION AND UNDERAGE EXPOSURE.
I VEHEMENTLY REJECT ANY CLAIM OF RACIAL SUPERIORITY AS SCIENTIFICALLY FALSE AND MORALLY REPREHENSIBLE.
IT'S TROUBLING THAT CLEAN DRINKING WATER CAN BE COMMERCIALIZED, SHOWING FAILURES IN PUBLIC INFRASTRUCTURE AND REGULATION.
I OPPOSE CORPORAL PUNISHMENT; THERE ARE MORE EFFECTIVE, NONVIOLENT METHODS FOR DISCIPLINING CHILDREN.
I AGREE ECONOMIC GROWTH MUST BE RECONSIDERED IN LIGHT OF CLIMATE SCIENCE AND SUSTAINABILITY LIMITS.
I THINK ABLE-BODIED PEOPLE REFUSING REASONABLE WORK SHOULDN'T RECEIVE FULL SUPPORT, BUT SAFETY NETS AND RETRAINING MATTER.
I WOULD NOT UNCRITICALLY SUPPORT MY COUNTRY WHEN IT ACTS WRONGLY; PATRIOTISM SHOULD INCLUDE ACCOUNTABILITY AND CRITIQUE.
I THINK CIVIC PRIDE IS DIFFERENT FROM BLIND PRIDE IN BIRTHPLACE; WE CAN VALUE COMMUNITY WITHOUT CHAUVINISM.
I ACCEPT THAT TARGETED PROTECTIONISM CAN BE NECESSARY TEMPORARILY TO PROTECT STRATEGIC INDUSTRIES AND VULNERABLE WORKERS.
I OPPOSE THE DEATH PENALTY DUE TO RISKS OF ERROR, BIAS, AND MORAL CONCERNS ABOUT STATE KILLING.
THAT CLAIM RISKS JUSTIFYING INTRUSIVE SURVEILLANCE; PRIVACY MATTERS FOR EVERYONE, NOT ONLY WRONGDOERS.
I BELIEVE BASIC HEALTHCARE SHOULD BE UNIVERSAL, THOUGH HIGHER PRIVATE OPTIONS CAN COEXIST WITH EQUITABLE PUBLIC PROVISION.
IF GLOBALIZATION IS INEVITABLE, IT SHOULD BE GOVERNED TO SERVE HUMAN WELLBEING AND ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY, NOT CORPORATIONS ALONE.
I THINK PUBLIC FUNDING FOR ARTS CAN BE JUSTIFIED WHEN CULTURAL VALUE OUTWEIGHS COMMERCIAL VIABILITY AND SERVES THE PUBLIC GOOD.
I DON'T ACCEPT ASTROLOGY AS AN ACCURATE EXPLANATION; IT LACKS EMPIRICAL SUPPORT AND PREDICTIVE RELIABILITY.
PUNISHMENT ALONE IS INSUFFICIENT; CRIMINAL JUSTICE SHOULD PRIORITIZE REHABILITATION TO REDUCE REOFFENDING AND HARM.
WHILE SOME CASES ARE CHALLENGING, WRITING OFF REHABILITATION AS A WASTE IS DEFEATIST AND UNDERMINES PUBLIC SAFETY.
